mvp_description: Metal plating and finishing management platform for plating companies

top_buyers.name: Lake City Plating
top_buyers.fit_rationale: ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949:2016 certified plating company with facilities in Jefferson, OH (Ashtabula County). Job tracking and quality management platform would support their high-volume and small lot order capabilities. Two locations in Ashtabula County.

top_buyers.name: Lakeside Custom Plating
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Veteran-owned business in Conneaut, OH offering restorations, copper, nickel, chrome plating. Specializes in classic auto industry and pot metal restoration. Digital platform would help manage restoration projects and customer communications. Best in industry warranty.

additional_contacts.name: Crown Metal Plating
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: One of the largest plating providers in Northeast Ohio with nearly two acres of automation. Platform could integrate with their advanced production systems.

additional_contacts.name: Aetna Plating
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Cleveland-based plating company serving automotive, aerospace, and military customers. Platform would support stringent specification tracking.

additional_contacts.name: Techmetals
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: 50+ years experience with Nadcap, ISO, AS9100D certifications. Management platform would enhance their robust quality systems.

research_notes: Lake City Plating has excellent contact infrastructure with multiple department emails verified. Lakeside Custom Plating has verified general email. Both are strong local targets in Ashtabula County.
